$comment: The docs site's settings. Everything that names the product or decides who can read the docs lives here, so a rebrand is this file plus the four --dx-brand-* colours in shared/docs-tokens.css. docs/how-to-write-docs.md explains each line.

email.$comment: Who the platform's emails come from: the name people see, and the address (it must be on a domain verified in Resend: production has verxyl.com and agent.verxyl.com, read 2026-11-02; clearway.verxyl.com is NOT verified). Nobody reads no-reply@, so no email may ask for a reply. An empty address uses the address the server already sends from (CLIENT_EMAIL_FROM, else DIGITAL_WALL_EMAIL_FROM), with this name. lib/mail/send.ts.
